title: Registration
subtitle: Walk-in registration: patient, contract, services, discount and payment in one screen. Enter adds a service, F2 opens the picker, Ctrl+S saves.
editSubtitle: Add or release services, change the details or the discount of a saved visit. Nothing is deleted.
